sourcePolicy: Generate surroundings and ingredients only. Authentic product packaging remains an independent unchanged source-pixel layer. Archived facilities and the existing concept film remain separately classified.
resolutionPolicy: Historical prompts request an 8K quality aesthetic. Measured native photographic output is 1672x941, not 8K or native 4K. Desktop derivatives retain native dimensions. Exact 720x960 mobile cover requires about 2.02% mechanical enlargement, recorded without a claim of added detail. Ingredient foreground is downsampled with lossless WebP encoding and preserved alpha.
